maddeler.e:
نتكربن (form IIq)
# نَتَكَرْبَنُ (natakarbanu) /na.ta.kar.ba.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَكَرْبَنَ (takarbana)
# نَتَكَرْبَنَ (natakarbana) /na.ta.kar.ba.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَكَرْبَنَ (takarbana)
# نَتَكَرْبَنْ (natakarban) /na.ta.kar.ban/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَكَرْبَنَ (takarbana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
